new_evaluation_storage.description: Exact torchvision PNG bytes buffered in host RAM; original official ImagePathDataset, transforms, Inception batch256 and scorer retained.

training_reproducibility_limit: Round11 and12 use identical method, seeds, shards and exposure, but480 parameter tensor byte checks differ. Round12 removes injected LD_PRELOAD. Therefore the historical round10→12 time-sampling comparison has an execution-environment confound; do not attribute its entire improvement to time sampling. Round12→15 uses the same execution environment,16updates and latehalf sampler, changing teacher proposal multiplier2→8; optimizer storage is lossless and its CPU time is budgeted but excluded from effective research duration.
uncertainty_note: Frozen sampling seed0. Saved-weight revalidation tests deterministic reproducibility, not cross-seed significance. No 3-sigma sufficiency claim.

fid_uncertainty_diagnostic.limitations: Candidate-only first-order block jackknife. Baseline sampling variability, covariance of paired baseline/candidate outputs and training variability are unestimated. This does not establish the operator paired3sigma sufficiency criterion.
